page.notes: Several Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words in the text are hard to read and are given as best as possible; the Hebrew words in particular should be checked against the scan. The Greek word for "animal" near the top and the Hebrew "animal" are uncertain. The word after "ex" in the last line is partly unclear. The marginal note "Animalia sermonis..." runs over three lines and is reconstructed from the scan. Half-line at the top of the page is a continuation from the previous page. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
